title: "ignoring unknown package" in colcon build --packages-select: names vs folders, COLCON_IGNORE, nested packages and exit code 0, measured
excerpt: Why colcon build --packages-select prints ignoring unknown package, builds nothing and exits 0: package.xml names vs folders, case, dashes, commas, COLCON_IGNORE, nested and hidden folders, wrong workspace, and two ways to make CI fail. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
